irregularities.action_taken: Validator and writer use the SAMPLE footprint (the submission format's own grid) and the all-finite zeros encoding, so the discrepancy cannot leak a -3.4e38 sentinel or NaN into a submission. Inherited fleet note; flagged for template fix.

irregularities.finding: Uniqueness gate (protocol S1, strict reading): candidate dot overlap within 3px exceeds 70% against three registry rasters — 13gems lattice-s5 null (0.9959; 206,895 dots on a ~5px lattice, so any candidate is ~100% within 3px by construction), gems10 ctx-ridge (0.8783; 174,232 positive px, continuous ridge), gems10 dotted-ridge (0.8206; 69,281 dots) and 8GEMSDOE Hedge-v2 (0.7077; 227,507 positive px). Against every operating-point-comparable dotted submission (37k-46k dots: d2.8 family, H32 family, h33-2-b2 winner) overlap is 0.397-0.497 and surface Spearman |rho| <= 0.224 everywhere.
irregularities.action_taken: Logged as duplicate-risk under the strict protocol reading; promotion stopped (verdict already negative on holdout). The comparable-budget reading passes, the any-raster reading fails; a human must decide which registry class the 70% rule governs before any future candidate from this surface is promoted. Numbers in evidence/uniqueness.json.

irregularities.finding: The 0.2778 winner raster (CTRL_h33) scores HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0046 on gems85-pooled-hide-v1 because it was constructed by pruning dots <=2px from the FULL catalogue — withheld segments are excluded by construction, so the instrument cannot credit it. It is invalid as a holdout promotion bar (same defect GEMSDOE71 recorded for static h33).
irregularities.action_taken: Promotion bar set to the best valid control, CTRL_d28 (HOLDOUT-DTI 0.102305). Both controls are reported with this caveat wherever they appear.
